paper_title: Automatic Evaluation of Attribution by Large Language Models
caption: Data source distribution of combined training and AttrEval-Simulation sets.
model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of data sources utilized in the AttrEval-Simulation dataset. The chart contains six slices representing six distinct data sources: WEBQUESTIO in blue, with approximately 3.6%, ENTITYQUEST in blue, with approximately 26.0%, TRIVIAQA in blue, with approximately 22.7%, TREC in orange, with approximately 1.9%, POP-QA in yellow, with approximately 21.6%, and HOTPOTQA in yellow, with approximately 24.2%. The chart includes percentage labels displayed within each slice, and the slices appear to be ordered from largest to smallest in terms of their area. A legend is not present, and no slices are visually emphasized through techniques such as explosion or offset.
